description: This file defines an abstract repository interface for persistence operations related to service requests and their events. It includes protocols, abstract methods, and type annotations to specify expected behaviors for concrete implementations.

classes.name: SupportsClose
classes.description: Protocol for repositories that support explicit close/teardown.

classes.name: Repository
classes.description: Abstract repository interface for persistence operations over Service Requests and their associated events.

methods.name: ServiceRequestRead create_request(self, payload: ServiceRequestCreate)
methods.description: Create a new service request with initial status and timestamps, returning the created request as a read schema.

methods.name: Optional[ServiceRequestRead] get_request_by_id(self, request_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve a request by its identifier, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Tuple[int,list[ServiceRequestRead]] list_requests( self, filters: Optional[ServiceRequestListFilters] = None, )
methods.description: List requests matching optional filters with pagination, returning total count and list of requests.

methods.name: Optional[RequestEventRead] add_event( self, request_id: int, status: RequestStatus, comment: str, created_by: str, )
methods.description: Append an event to a given request, returning the created event or None if request doesn't exist.

methods.name: list[RequestEventRead] list_events_for_request(self, request_id: int)
methods.description: List all events associated with a given request, ordered by creation time.

methods.name: Optional[ServiceRequestRead] update_status( self, request_id: int, status: RequestStatus, comment: Optional[str], updated_by: str )
methods.description: Update the status of a request and add an event; return the updated request or None if not found.

methods.name: bool delete_request(self, request_id: int)
methods.description: Delete a request and its associated events, returning True if successful.

ctags.name: add_event
ctags.signature: ( self, request_id: int, status: RequestStatus, comment: str, created_by: str, )
